business_problem: Tsinghua University needed large-scale, precisely annotated video data to advance gigapixel computer-vision research, but building such a dataset required industrial-scale collection, slicing, labeling, and management that academic teams could not easily execute alone.
solution_summary: Tsinghua University worked with Baidu AI Cloud's data-crowdsourcing services to expand the PANDA gigapixel video dataset. The engagement focused on large-scale data production rather than a user-facing app: Baidu supplied integrated capabilities spanning data collection, labeling, storage, management, and training support so the university could enrich PANDA with far more detailed scene understanding. The delivered work included more than 7,200 gigapixel frames, over 1.06 million image tiles, tens of thousands of object relationships, hundreds of thousands of interaction behaviors and trajectory points, and semantic or instance labels for billions of 3D point-cloud elements. That transformed PANDA into a stronger foundation for research in public safety, smart cities, and virtual reality.

solution_components.name: Data Collection Service
solution_components.role: Provides the large-scale data-production and collection capabilities used to expand the PANDA dataset.

solution_components.name: Data Collection and Annotation Solution
solution_components.role: Supplies the labeling, management, and training-support workflow for gigapixel video data and point-cloud annotations.

data_flow: Gigapixel source frames are collected and cut into smaller tiles, then pass through large-scale annotation workflows for object relations, behaviors, trajectories, and 3D point-cloud labeling. The resulting structured dataset is delivered back to Tsinghua for PANDA research and GigaVision competition tracks.
business_outcome: Tsinghua gained a much richer video-research dataset and a scalable annotation pipeline that supports advanced computer-vision research, benchmark creation, and future public-safety or smart-city applications.
metrics: The project produced more than 1.06 million image tiles.
The dataset includes nearly 20,000 object relationships.
The dataset includes nearly 200,000 interaction behaviors.
The dataset includes nearly 300,000 moving-object trajectory point groups.
The project labeled billions of 3D point-cloud data points.

evidence_quotes: Baidu AI Cloud data-crowdsourcing services collaborated with Tsinghua University to advance PANDA, the world's first gigapixel video dataset (original: 百度智能云数据众包与清华大学开展项目合作，推进全球首个十亿像素级视频数据集 PANDA 的建设工作).

The project completed more than 7,200 gigapixel frames and over 1.06 million cut images, along with object relationships, behaviors, trajectory points, and semantic or instance labels for billions of 3D point-cloud data points (original: 本次项目共完成7200余帧亿级像素图片，共计超过106万张切图的数据标注工作，包括物体间关系近2万组、交互行为近20万个、移动物体轨迹点近30万组，以及数十亿 3D 点云数据的语义分割及实例标注).
Baidu positioned the service as an integrated capability covering collection, labeling, storage, management, and training for AI data (original: 百度数据众包…具备数据“采、标、存、管、训”一体化的服务能力).

The expanded dataset supports future research and challenge tracks in public safety, smart cities, virtual reality, and GigaVision competitions (original: 用以支持未来在公共安全、智慧城市、虚拟现实等领域的各项研究及应用…为清华大学后续举办的 GigaVision…挑战赛提供数据支持).
